lists.text: Team & Position Overview
lists.content:
The Client Engagement Team (CET) is the analytical and consultative backbone of Analytic Partners. Our model is hands-on: the people who partner with clients also prepare, analyse, and deliver data-driven insights, helping them use our technology solutions to make better decisions. Because all work is completed in-house, this high-touch approach requires strong analytics capability, clear communication, commercial curiosity, and a consultative mindset to help clients grow ROI.

As a Consultant with Analytic Partners, you will advise and partner with leading Australian, New Zealand, and global brands, influencing strategic and tactical planning across marketing and broader business priorities. Your work will help uncover growth opportunities worth tens of millions of dollars, supported by strong client relationships and engagement with senior audiences, from brand managers and media directors to CMOs and CEOs. You will deepen your expertise in marketing, analytics, and business drivers, using predictive models and client data to identify what drives sales, appointments, accounts, brand health, or any other outcome our clients want to grow.

You will split your time between collaborating with colleagues and clients and working independently. We support your development through immersive onboarding Bootcamp, which builds the technical and conceptual foundations for success, as well as ongoing training in new methodologies, consulting skills, and career growth.

The Consultant role will span across multiple projects and includes processing data, building models, and creating presentations that translate analysis into clear insights and recommendations. You will also guide junior analysts in their day-to-day work and career development, while contributing to company-wide initiatives beyond client delivery.

lists.text: What you’ll be doing:
lists.content:
• Lead multiple customer engagements day-to-day, in collaboration with CET leadership, to help  customers make optimal investment decisions based on the combination of our proprietary technology and advisory services.
  • Manage customer delivery: align project timelines, manage key customer communication, manage tasks and goals of other team members, ensure deliverables are of high quality and meet project deadlines.
  • Accountable for driving the most efficient data collection process with customers and build cutting edge statistical/econometric models.
  • Build strong relationships with customers understand their business objectives and deliver presentations with actionable insights and recommendations to drive impactand long-term partnerships.
  • Act as point of contact for customer projects, being able to address ad-hoc client requests and questions about data, models, software, etc.
  • Collaborate with leadership to balance project resources across teams, and support in managing towards revenue targets.
  • Train and coach new & existing team members, providing feedback and guidance in the moment during daily work.
  • Work on a hybrid model, with team members spending at least three days each week in our North Sydney office to support team collaboration, connection, and client impact.

lists.text: What we look for in you:
lists.content:
• Bachelor’s degree or above (ideal areas of study/related study including: Business Analytics and Management, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, and/or Marketing)
  • 5+ years of experience in marketing mix modeling, digital media analysis, business focused analytics, advertising effectiveness analysis or other related client insights experience
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel
  • Highly analytical with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Project and people management experience
  • Experience developing and presenting presentations using insights derived from analytics
  • Ability to apply marketing and commercial intelligence concepts for business success
  • You must be eligible to work in Australia on an unlimited basis to be considered for this job.

lists.content:

  • Effective Communication - utilises data to tell a story and not just present facts

  • Creative Collaboration - collaborates upward and actively works to bring in outside perspectives
  • Harnessing Innovation - technifies existing practices by leveraging knowledge and innovative solutions

lists.text: POSITION & TEAM OVERVIEW:
lists.content:
• This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship
  • Must be willing to commit to minimum 6 months for this internship
  • Position: Data Science Co-Op FY27 (6 or 8 month Co-Op Program)
  • Starting Date: January 2027
    •  
    Analytic Partners Science Team develops algorithms and technologies using the mathematical framework to address business challenges analytically. The algorithms and technologies then feed into Analytic Partners’ analytical engines! The Science Team is an integral part of R&D Group who is the core of Analytic Partners software as a service platform. The team is comprised of motivated individuals that do exceptional work. They face challenges together and they win together. As a Data Scientist Intern, you’ll collaborate with a fun and agile team to research, architect, implement, test, and continuously deliver new features and products to our company and clients! You also have opportunities to work with clients to develop customized models and solutions to address their business challenges.
     
    Why participate:
  • This would be a great opportunity if you are eager to apply quantitative analysis theories and techniques you learn at school to real-world solutions and you’re passionate about working with data.
  • You will thrive in our collaborative work environments and grow personally and professionally.
  • You will be challenged to harness innovation and are constantly looking for ways to improve.
    •  
    Participants will:
  • Creatively apply science methodology and techniques solving real-world problems to generate business impact.
  • Conduct Data Science methodology research and derive novel analytical solutions to expand company solution capabilities and options.
  • Work closely with cross function business teams on client engagement and implementation Discover and address users’ pain points to enhance AP analytics platform. 
    •  
    YOU WILL OWN & COLLABORATE ON:
  • Conduct data analysis using various tools and techniques.
  • Assist in documenting model specifications and implementation details.
  • Assist team members in developing and implementing statistical, ML and AI solutions, models, and algorithms.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business needs and requirements.
    •  
    QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE YOU WILL NEED:
  • Minimum:
  • Solid technical skills in probability & statistics, machine learning and optimization algorithms.
  • Proficient in Python and SQL.

lists.text: What you’ll be doing:
lists.content:
• The Director role is responsible for leading and cultivating Customer engagements and building and managing a team of consultants and analysts in the delivery of our solutions to major advertisers. The Director plays a prominent role as a customer and team lead with hands-on involvement in project management, business interpretation and application, Customer communication, insights/results delivery and ultimately the adoption of technology and the analytics program within the Customer organization. Directors are also expected to share new and innovative ideas, lead/participate in global corporate initiatives. You will collaborate with your peers by developing resourcing plans, managing revenue goals, and contributing to new business development.
  • Strategically manage a portfolio of accounts and provide thought leadership to delight the Customer; Understanding Customer business objectives and provide actionable insights and recommendations for analytic engagements including but not limited to Commercial/Marketing Mix Models, Paid Owned & Earned Media Effectiveness, Cross Media, or Multi-Touch Attribution, Test-and-Learn or Experimental Design, Pricing Strategy, Customer Segmentation Analyses and Marketing Investment Optimization. You will understand the differences and bridge gaps between various types of research & customer insights.
  • Provide hands-on Team leadership to ensure timely and effective Customer deliverables. Drive objectives by communicating and managing expectations; planning, monitoring, evaluating, and reviewing progress; anticipating and diplomatically resolving potential issues with internal and Customer partners. 
  • Drive efficient and effective Customer delivery, with an eye on account profitability. Be a steward for adopting technology, utilizing standard delivery approaches, ensuring consistent and robust documentation, and continuously improving our delivery process
  • Lead the team to develop and deliver insightful presentations that demonstrate tangible value and Customer impact. Providing expert consultative advice to Customers with confidence and clarity
  • Infuse industry knowledge and business acumen to help drive adoption of analytic insights and software in Customer decision processes
  • Manage towards revenue and profitability goals. Work with the VP CET Leadership to manage Customer contract renewals and upsell opportunities. Actively seek opportunities to grow account relationships through additional solutions, brands, analytic dimensions, and geographies.
  • Collaborate with CET partners and Finance to keep financial systems up to date.
  • Partner with other CET Directors and VPs across regional offices to ensure sufficient and balanced resourcing
  • Train and coach new & existing team members, guiding career growth and leading performance management discussions
  • Lead and/or contribute significantly to internal corporate initiatives to drive a culture of agility and organizational efficiency for scalability
  • Contribute to the company’s overall growth by supporting and collaborating with the business development function to drive new customer acquisition and lead generation activities
  • Lead by example; Communicate, embody, and advocate for Analytic Partners vision and values. Support and drive a culture of accountability, empowerment and engagement while recognizing and appreciating diverse needs.

lists.text: What we look for in you:
lists.content:
• Bachelor’s degree or above (ideal areas of study/related study include: Business Analytics and Management, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, and/or Marketing)
  • 10+ years of experience with marketing mix modeling, digital media analysis, business focused analytics, advertising effectiveness analysis or other related statistical modeling experience
  • Proficient working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel
  • Highly analytical with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Strong Project Management skills with the ability to organize and prioritize schedules
  • Strong customer management skills to handle tricky situations diplomatically and manage customer expectations
  • Experience leading and working with a team developing and delivering presentations with insights that deliver value to customers
  • Proven success with customer delivery of advanced analytics programs such as marketing mix modeling and unified measurement
  • The ability to occasionally travel domestically and/or internationally
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

lists.text: What you’ll be doing:
lists.content:
Analytic Partners has no shortage of data, expertise, or interesting questions.  

This role is about turning that raw material into clear, credible, and compelling perspectives that help shape how senior leaders think about measurement, growth, and commercial decision-making. 

The Insights & Thought Leadership Manager role sits at the intersection of research, analytics, writing, and commercial strategy. It is designed for someone equally comfortable interrogating a chart, challenging an argument, and turning a complicated idea into a memorable story or graphic. 

 Develop thought leadership:  

  • Produce strong first drafts of blog posts, LinkedIn posts, research reports, whitepaper sections, and executive presentations.  

  • Revise arguments to improve clarity, differentiation, evidence, and executive resonance.  

  • Help turn individual findings into ownable frameworks and coherent narratives, not simply a parade of charts.  

  • Collaborate with subject-matter experts, Marketing, Client Engagement, Product, and other contributors to strengthen content.  

 Shape research and insights:

  • Identify important questions Analytic Partners can credibly answer about commercial decisioning, modern measurement, and intelligent growth.  

  • Translate broad themes into focused research questions, hypotheses, and evidence plans.  

  • Develop compelling charts, graphs, tables, and evidence summaries.  

  • Connect findings across sources and create reusable evidence packages containing claims, definitions, sources, interpretation, and caveats.  

  • Integrate relevant academic, industry, competitive, and practitioner research to extend credibility and usability of existing narratives.   

  • Analyze and synthesize findings from ROI Genome, the State of Commercial Decisioning Survey, and other owned Analytic Partners evidence sources.  

 

The role will be part of the Commercial Enablement team at Analytic Partners within the Office of the CEO.

lists.text: What makes someone excellent in this role?
lists.content: An excellent candidate is a curious lifelong learner with a history of drawing connections others miss. They can think conceptually while chasing down the details that make an argument credible and move a project forward.  They ask fruitful questions of data without disappearing into every available rabbit hole. Faced with a broad topic, they can provide structure.

lists.text: What we look for in you:
lists.content:
• Strong research, synthesis, and critical-thinking skills.  

  • Excellent business writing and editing skills.  

  • Ability to interpret data and translate findings into accurate, compelling stories.  

  • Sound judgment regarding claims, evidence, definitions, and caveats.  

  • Confidence collaborating with senior subject-matter experts and cross-functional partners.  

  • Ability to manage multiple research and content workstreams.  

  • Proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel.  

 Experience with thought leadership, market research, survey analysis, or marketing measurement is preferred. Experience with cross-tabulation, hypothesis testing, correlation analysis, or SPSS is beneficial but not essential. Training can be provided.  

Up to 15% travel.

lists.text: Team & Position Overview
lists.content:
We're hiring a Senior Manager of Sales Development: based in our Singapore office. You'll open doors with enterprise marketing leaders, build relationships, and develop qualified new-business opportunities for senior business development colleagues to take forward and close.
 
The position is hybrid and reports to the Asia Managing Director. This is an individual-contributor role focused on early-stage business development, not managing a sales team or having final negotiations. You'll work closely with local leaders, marketing, and solutions experts, combining in-person events and networking with inbound lead qualification and proactive outbound prospecting.
 
Our prospects include CMOs, heads of marketing, and other in-house marketing leaders at companies with substantial media and marketing investment. Our enterprise agreements combine consulting services with enterprise SaaS, and sales cycles typically run from 6 months to as long as 18 months for large enterprises. You'll build credibility, understand initial needs, and sustain relationships through that process.

lists.text: What you’ll be doing:
lists.content:
• Build a pipeline of qualified new-business opportunities through targeted research, cold calling, email outreach, and your own networking.
    • Follow up on marketing-generated leads, establish initial relationships, and assess their relevance to our solutions.
      • Work with local leaders and marketing to attend relevant industry events, represent Analytic Partners, and turn new connections into ongoing conversations.
        • Research target companies, their marketing priorities, and the issues shaping their industries to make outreach relevant.
          • Engage CMOs, heads of marketing, and other decision-makers in initial discovery conversations about business goals, measurement challenges, and potential needs.
            • Nurture relationships over long enterprise sales cycles, coordinating follow-up with marketing and senior business development colleagues.
              • Hand qualified opportunities to senior business development colleagues with clear context on stakeholders, initial needs, and agreed next steps; support continuity as they take ownership of the opportunity and closing process.
                • Use thought-leadership content and solutions expertise to help prospects understand our approach to marketing and commercial decision-making.
                  • Maintain accurate Salesforce records of contacts, activity, qualification findings, and pipeline progress.
                    • Develop and progress qualified opportunities to support team revenue targets, prioritizing relevance and quality as well as activity.

lists.text: What we look for in you:
lists.content:
• At least 5-8 years of demonstrated success generating and qualifying enterprise opportunities for marketing data, analytics, or software solutions.
    • Experience engaging enterprise marketing decision-makers in initial needs discovery.
      • An understanding of consultative enterprise sales, multiple buyer stakeholders, and the persistence required for long sales cycles.
        • The ability to discuss how data and analytics can improve marketing returns and business performance, and recognise when to bring in a solutions expert.
          • Confidence building professional relationships through local industry events, networking, phone conversations, and written outreach.
            • A proactive approach to researching prospects and creating opportunities, alongside effective collaboration with marketing and senior business development colleagues.
              • Experience using Salesforce to maintain accurate contact and pipeline records and report on progress.
                • Clear communication, active listening, and the ability to build rapport and trust with senior stakeholders.
                  • The ability to manage multiple prospect relationships and follow-through independently without losing detail or momentum.

  • Provide strategic guidance and recommendations to customers based on data-driven insights. This includes (but not limited to) helping customers understand their target audience, optimize marketing spend, and measure the impact of their efforts.

  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel
  • Experience working independently on analytical tasks, building, and optimizing ‘big data’ pipelines, architectures, and data sets.
  • Experience developing and delivering presentations using insights derived from analytics.
  • Experience using data to solve complex business questions and demonstrate an awareness of the broader business impacts that drive business solutions.
  • Account management and customer success skills, including strong written and verbal communication.
  • Experience collaborating with others to implement change initiatives.

lists.text: What we value in you:
lists.content:
• You’ve got positive energy and you’re passionate about working with data. You’re optimistic about the future of using data to make informed business decisions.  
  • You’re never tired of learning and are always looking for ways to grow personally and professionally 
  • You thrive in collaborative work environments . You’re both an active communicator and an eager listener - because let’s face it, you can’t have one without the other. 
  • You can pivot on the fly. Analytics is constantly changing, and we need to keep adapting and evolving that change too. What you worked on last month may not be what you work on today, and that excites you. 
  • You have a “can do” attitude. Our teams create high-quality work on quick timelines.  
  • Do you enjoy owning a problem and see it as an opportunity to innovate and challenge the status quo? We’re all about harnessing innovation and are constantly looking for ways to improve 
  • You want to be part of a winning team. We’re stronger together, and you’re a person who embraces being pushed out of your comfort zone.

lists.text: What you’ll be doing:
lists.content:
• Be a subject matter expert – develop deep knowledge of our data, platform, and dependencies on other systems; act as a trusted adviser for our project teams and customers and turn business requirements into feature specifications; support our project teams and customers in the understanding and usage of existing features
  • Provide data collection, prep, and validation related support to project teams and customers
  • Collaborate with project teams, customers, Product Managers, and Engineers to analyze and help resolve process and product related issues
  • Conduct research and analysis to understand business, process, and product challenges; make recommendations on how to resolve issues
  • Gather and analyze data to better understand needs and tracking against OKRs
  • Write requirements, functional specifications, and other supporting documentation for new and updated features and functionality
  • Test new and updated features and functionality. Work closely with Engineers on feature and functionality development to ensure alignment to specs.
  • Work with QA Engineers to ensure successful planning of test strategy and test case execution.

lists.text: What we look for in you:
lists.content:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in STEM, Economics, or Statistics
  • 0-2 years of work experience as a Data Analyst or in a Product support role
  • Knowledge of SQL, relational databases, data cloud platforms, or ETL tools
  • Knowledge of Office 365
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • The ability to influence stakeholders and work closely with them to determine acceptable solutions.
  • Excellent multitasking and time management skill to manage stakeholders and to meet tight deadlines
  • Nice to have: Experience with Jira and Confluence
